targets.corrected_statement: A first time Nevada driver license issued to a person under age sixty five is valid for eight years and expires on the birthday unless limited term immigration documents are presented, in which case expiration follows the verified departure date or one year if none is provided.
targets.note: Added the limited term immigration document exception that the original omitted.

targets.corrected_statement: A first time license for a person under age sixty five is valid for eight years unless limited term immigration documents apply, a license for a person age sixty five or older is valid for four years, and an identification card is valid for eight years.
targets.note: Added the limited term immigration document exception missing from the summary.

targets.corrected_statement: Do not leave a child aged seven or younger alone in a vehicle when conditions create a significant risk to health and safety unless a person at least twelve years old supervises the child and keeps the child in sight.
targets.note: Added the missing limiting condition about significant risk to health and safety.

targets.corrected_statement: White lines may separate same direction traffic but are also used to mark highway edges and shoulders and crosswalks and stop lines while yellow lines separate opposite direction traffic.
targets.note: Removed always because white lines have other uses besides separating same direction traffic.

targets.corrected_statement: Three different six-month rules apply to Nevada teens: hold the permit at least six months, carry no non-family passengers under 18 for the first six months of licensed driving, and stay crash- and conviction-free for six months before licensing.
targets.note: The crash-free rule is stated on page 14, not on the cited page 15.

targets.corrected_statement: To qualify for a license you must have binocular vision and visual acuity of at least twenty over forty in each eye and a continuous field of vision of at least one hundred forty degrees.
targets.note: Removed the definition of both eyes working together because the page only lists the term without defining it.

targets.corrected_statement: In a hydroplane you do not brake, while in a skid you may brake once the tires grip again.
targets.note: The skid brake-after-traction rule is on page 29, not page 30.

targets.corrected_statement: A provisional license holder may drive unsupervised between twelve midnight and five in the morning only when driving to from or during a job or to or from an organized volunteer program an official school activity or an athletic event or related training session.
targets.note: Added the three missing nighttime exceptions beyond work.

targets.corrected_statement: A steady red requires you to stay stopped for as long as it is red, whereas after stopping at a flashing red you may go once the way is clear.
targets.note: The flashing-red proceed-when-clear rule is on page 18, not page 17.

targets.corrected_statement: Front wheel drive or four wheel drive vehicles require easy acceleration to pull out of a skid.
targets.note: Removed the added vehicle instructions condition that the page does not state for this note.

targets.corrected_statement: Two feet of moving water can carry away most vehicles including sport utility vehicles and pickup trucks.
targets.note: Changed many vehicles to most vehicles to match page wording.

targets.corrected_statement: Keep enough distance between you and other vehicles because doing so not only protects you but also prevents wear and tear on your vehicle.
targets.note: Removed reducing unnecessary braking which the page does not state.

targets.corrected_statement: For a 3-speed transmission, the manual generally describes third gear for speeds above 25 miles per hour.
targets.note: The complete rule is stated on page 45, not page 44.

targets.corrected_statement: A five sided sign means you are in a school zone and you must slow to fifteen miles per hour during recess, when children are going to or leaving school, from one half hour before the start of the school day to one half hour after the end of the school day, or when school speed limit signs are flashing during school opening or closing hours.

targets.corrected_statement: Pickup passengers younger than 19 must use the passenger compartment, except qualifying work or training travel, licensed-hunter travel to or from hunting, parade participation, or a belted manufacturer-installed outside seat.
targets.note: Statement is correct but the final exception is printed on page 120, not page 119.

targets.corrected_statement: If your vehicle turn signals do not work, use hand signals to signal when changing direction.

targets.note: Removed left arm upward detail not stated in provided text.

targets.corrected_statement: If you must drive below forty miles per hour on a limited access highway, use your hazard flashers to warn the drivers behind you.
targets.note: Removed left arm downward detail not stated in provided text.

targets.corrected_statement: Increasing the amount of time between drinks is the best way to slow down the effect of drinking alcohol.

targets.corrected_statement: Sound a sharp blast on your horn when a child or older person is about to enter the street, when another vehicle is about to hit you, or when you have lost control of your vehicle and are moving toward someone.

targets.corrected_statement: For the first move of a three point turn, activate the left turn signal and check traffic and blind spots over your left shoulder, and when traffic is clear turn hard left to the other side of the road and stop after reaching the other side.

targets.corrected_statement: A Class Three low speed electric bicycle has a motor that engages only when the rider is pedaling and provides assistance up to twenty eight miles per hour, and operators must be at least sixteen years old.

targets.corrected_statement: You should avoid eating while driving.
